SBP: There is clarity about the work that the team should be doing and how to accomplish the work of the team
I am allowed to use my unique personal skills and abilities for the benefit of the team
I have a clear understanding of what other team members expect of me as a team member
Roles and responsibilities of individual team members are clearly understood by all members of the team
On this team the person who takes the lead differs depending on who is best suited for the task
Team members follow the leadership of other team members
The goals of the team are clearly understood by all team members
The team openly discusses decisions that affect the work of the team before they are made
Team members participate in making decisions about the work of the team

Team has to decide whether patient should be discharged to home (with or without home health/home therapies), discharged to inpatient neurorehab, or needs to stay in hospital for further evaluation/management
ICS: All team members feel free to share their ideas with the team
All team members feel free to express their feelings with the team
Team members say what they really think and mean
Regardless of the topic, communication between the people on this team is direct, truthful, respectful and positive
The work I do on this team is valued by the other team members
On this team, members support and encourage each other
Information that is important for the team to have is openly shared by and with all team members
Team should ask for input from patient about home environment and include patient in shared decision making about discharge plan
PBLI: The team has agreed upon clear criteria for evaluating the outcomes of the team’s effort
PROF: Team members talk about each other with respect, even when team members are not present
The team practices tolerance, flexibility and appreciation of the unique differences between team members
In the team, there is more of a WE feeling than a ME feeling
Team members define the goals of the team as more important than their own personal goals
